subject: Continue normal green integration into dev during demo preparation
question: Does demo preparation freeze dev or stop otherwise authorized updates?
decision: Owner, 2026-11-03: "I'm told dev is frozen, why? We should still be pushing updates to dev!" Continue merging and pushing completed, probes-green authorized work into dev through the established task-branch integration workflow. Supersedes ODR-DEMO-FREEZE-20261031 where it limits dev to DR0-DR7, parks otherwise authorized tasks, or holds dev at a release candidate. Demo priorities, other scoped owner answers, security, protected assets, budgets, save/device/child/owner acceptance and dev-to-master release gates retain their scopes. This is no new feature commission or release instruction.
